# Orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Orientation`](gmeow-Orientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Orientation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The rotational component of a pose, expressed as co-equal optional facets: quaternion (x, y, z, w), Euler angles (yaw, pitch, roll plus order), or compass angles (heading, bearing). No single representation is privileged; multiple representations may coexist for the same pose. Aligns by reference to IEEE 1872-2015 [pos:OrientationMeasure.](http://purl.org/ieee1872-owl/pos#OrientationMeasure.)
